purpose: Test candidate EEG feature implementations on cohorts not used in the feature-source papers. Results may reject rather than validate the feature set.
target: Physical stimulus intensity, using source-defined columns; never replace missing physical labels with subjective ratings.

heat_f2mua.title: The temporal and spectral characteristics of expectations and prediction errors in pain and thermoception
heat_f2mua.binary_target: Higher temperature (46 or 48 degrees) versus lower temperature (42 degrees). This is NOT a subjective pain/no-pain diagnosis.

shock_w25k4.title: Tonic pain re-values associative memories of phasic pain: a combined VR-EEG study
shock_w25k4.binary_target: PCollShock versus PCollNoShock following pain-associated cues; omit non-pain-associated cues. Actual per-trial current in mA is not supplied.
shock_w25k4.limitation: Dose presence/absence, NOT continuous current magnitude. Tonic block context and source preprocessing are possible confounds.

sampling: Select 10 participant files per cohort by SHA256(seed:dataset:filename) rank, before any predictive scores. No selection by performance. Log failed downloads/schema/quality exclusions; do not replace excluded participants based on scores.
cross_dataset_primary: Two directed tests: train on one entire cohort and evaluate on the other, with no target-cohort fitting or model tuning. This tests transfer of the source-defined low/higher stimulus contrast, NOT transfer of absolute Celsius into milliamps.
within_dataset_secondary: Four-fold GroupKFold by participant. Heat: native temperature regression plus binary contrast. Shock: delivered/omitted classification only.

classification: ExtraTreesClassifier n_estimators=200 max_depth=8 min_samples_leaf=8 max_features=0.7 class_weight=balanced

family_ablation: For each compatible family, remove it from all_compatible and score the fixed logistic model on both directed holdouts; do not select a model using these results.

preprocessing.reference: Average of the prespecified common selected EEG electrodes
preprocessing.alignment: Fixed source hardware event; never shift time using a target temperature or shock label.
preprocessing.quality: Reject nonfinite or incomplete epochs, poststimulus absolute maximum >400 uV, prestimulus absolute maximum >200 uV, or median channel SD <0.05 uV. No label-conditioned cleaning.
preprocessing.missing_values: Median imputer and StandardScaler fit only on training rows; use keep_empty_features. Missing family coverage disclosed.

csp: Training-only supervised low/higher covariance contrast; two extreme generalized-eigenvector log-variance features. Never fit CSP on held-out subjects or target cohort. This is not PCA.
scope: New supervised validation, separate from prior unsupervised C3/C4/Cz state discovery. Prior outputs remain unchanged. No PCA.
metrics: R2 for heat native Celsius only
uncertainty: 1000 participant-cluster bootstrap replicates; 95% intervals, paired full-minus-power balanced-accuracy intervals. Cross-cohort training uncertainty is not included.
negative_control: 20 within-participant training-label permutations per direction for the all-compatible logistic model. Held-out labels never permuted for the observed score; all permutations reported.
interpretation_threshold: Predeclared operational meaning of 'great': both directed logistic holdouts have balanced accuracy >=0.80 with 95% lower bounds above 0.50 and positive full-minus-power gain on both. This is not a clinical threshold. Native temperature R2>=0.50 is reported separately, not required of a shock-presence target.
blindness_limitations: Public data and known study designs; retrospective computational holdout, not prospective or human-blinded clinical validation. Dataset/cohort disjointness is audited from provenance, not guaranteed by globally identifying individual participants.

unavailable_families.High-gamma response: Cross-cohort common pipeline ends at 40 Hz. Shock source was already low-pass filtered at 70 Hz. Do not substitute 30-40 Hz for the listed 60-100 Hz feature.
unavailable_families.CVUE/Piqβ: Published long-record upper-envelope/Piqβ threshold is not validly reproduced by short event epochs. Generic beta envelope CV goes under amplitude variability, not Piqβ.
unavailable_families.Evoked latencies/morphology: Fixed latency and waveform descriptors are family-level candidates, not a claimed replication of Hu's WF+MLRd implementation.
